name: Lingering Breeze
notes:
Applies to everyone healed by a gust, including gusts triggered through Shared Breath. Regeneration strength increases with each orb level. Amounts and duration are left for tuning.

In game (hwp_rog_sw_lingering_breeze, tested): 2/4/6 health a second for 4 s on everyone the gust heals (assumed); a timed heal, so it does not pause after a hit.
summary: Healing gusts also grant brief Health Regeneration after the initial heal.
